implementation_rules: Do not alter calculations or data meaning solely to fit new copy.
If a renamed state is stored as an enum, preserve the enum key when changing it would risk data migration; change only the user-facing label unless a deliberate model migration is approved.
For generated Briefing language, update prompt/template instructions so future outputs do not recreate banned metaphors.
For Signal Console, retain numeric scores only if the UI exposes what the score represents and why an account received it.
For Founding GTM, avoid causal wording unless the underlying data establishes causality.
